content: --- [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/XiYang6666/etched-extension)](LICENSE) ![Language](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-Kotlin-7f52ff?logo=kotlin) ![Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/versions-forge_1.20.1_|_neoforge_1.21.1-d7742f) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/XiYang6666/etched-extension)](https://github.com/XiYang6666/etched-extension/releases/latest) [![Build Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/XiYang6666/etched-extension/build.yml?branch=1.21.1)](https://github.com/XiYang6666/etched-extension/actions) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/XiYang6666/etched-extension?style=social)](https://github.com/XiYang6666/etched-extension/stargazers) [![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/etched-extension?logo=modrinth&label=downloads&style=flat)](https://modrinth.com/mod/etched-extension) [简体中文](https://github.com/XiYang6666/etched-extension/blob/1.20.1/README.md) | English --- 為 [Etched](https://github.com/jacksonhardaway/etched) 新增 [Meting-api](https://github.com/injahow/meting-api) 和網易雲音樂分享連結支援。 網易雲音樂透過 [ebnr api](https://github.com/XiYang6666/EvenBetterNeteaseResolver) 解析。 > ⚠️ 警告 > > 預設 API 位址不支援 VIP 歌曲。 > 使用非 VIP API 時，雖然可以成功刻錄 VIP 歌曲，但在播放過程中可能會發生錯誤。 ## 設定 您可以在設定檔 `etched_extension-common.toml` 中更改 **ebnr api** 的位址。 ## 範例 ![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XiYang6666/etched-extension/1.20.1/docs/images/example.png) --- ## 📜 授權條款 本專案以 [GPLv3 License](https://github.com/XiYang6666/etched-extension/blob/1.20.1/LICENSE) 開源釋出。
